Name: Jehozadak
Role: Father of Joshua the High Priest
Summary: Jehozadak (KJV 'Josedech' in Haggai) is named as the father of Joshua the high priest (Haggai 1:1). He was the high priest carried into Babylonian exile, so his son Joshua served as high priest of the return without his father beside him.
KeyStory: Jehozadak, the exiled high priest, is named as the father of Joshua, who served as high priest when the exiles returned and rebuilt.
RelatedPeople: Joshua, Son of Jehozadak; Seraiah, Son of Azariah
LifeLesson: Jehozadak went into exile and never came home — but his son rebuilt. Sometimes the greatest service is a son raised for a day the father never sees.
